contracts.name: InstrumentSpecificationV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'instrument-spec-v2-1'
specification_id must be lowercase SHA-256 (64 hex chars)
market, instrument_id, currency must be non-empty strings
contract_id if present must be non-empty string
profile must be InstrumentProfile enum
tick_size, quantity_step, contract_multiplier must be positive finite Decimal
point_value if present must be positive finite Decimal
effective_from must be timezone-aware UTC
effective_to if present must be timezone-aware UTC and > effective_from
evidence_ids must be non-empty and unique

contracts.name: OwnerAssumptionV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'owner-assumption-v2-1'
assumption_id must be lowercase SHA-256
assumption_type, market, instrument_id, decision_reference must be non-empty strings
effective_from must be timezone-aware UTC
effective_to if present must be UTC and > effective_from
decimal_values must be non-empty, uniquely named, lexically ordered
each decimal value must be finite Decimal
synthetic_test_only and owner_approved cannot both be true

contracts.name: CapabilityDeclarationV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'capability-declaration-v2-1'
declaration_id must be lowercase SHA-256
market, instrument_id must be non-empty strings
supported_order_types, required_data_fields, specification_ids, reason_codes must be unique
profile must be InstrumentProfile enum
supported_order_types must contain OrderType values
production_eligible and reason_codes cannot both be present

contracts.name: OrderIntentV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'order-intent-v2-1'
order_id, run_id, action_id must be lowercase SHA-256
market, instrument_id, configuration_version, execution_policy_version must be non-empty strings
contract_id if present must be non-empty string
quantity must be positive finite Decimal
side must be OrderSide enum
order_type must be OrderType enum
time_in_force must be TimeInForce enum
limit_price if present must be positive finite Decimal
stop_price if present must be positive finite Decimal
LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT require limit_price
STOP_MARKET and STOP_LIMIT require stop_price
MARKET cannot have limit_price or stop_price
submitted_at must be UTC
activation_at must be UTC and >= submitted_at
expires_at if present must be UTC and > activation_at
parent_order_id and replaces_order_id if present must be SHA-256 and not self-reference

contracts.name: OrderTransitionV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'order-transition-v2-1'
transition_id, order_id must be lowercase SHA-256
event_time must be UTC
from_state and to_state must be OrderState enums
from_state != to_state (transition must change state)
source_event_ids must be unique

contracts.name: FillV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'fill-v2-1'
fill_id, order_id, market_event_id must be lowercase SHA-256
market, instrument_id, currency, execution_rule_code, execution_policy_version must be non-empty strings
contract_id if present must be non-empty string
fill_time must be UTC
side must be OrderSide enum
quantity, economic_price, reference_price must be positive finite Decimal
friction must be finite Decimal
fee_total must be nonnegative finite Decimal

contracts.name: AccountingSnapshotV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'accounting-snapshot-v2-1'
snapshot_id, run_id must be lowercase SHA-256
as_of must be UTC
currency must be non-empty string
accounting_version must be non-empty string
cash, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, fees, funding, equity, initial_margin, maintenance_margin, available_funds must be finite Decimal
fees, initial_margin, maintenance_margin must be nonnegative
source_event_ids must be unique

contracts.name: RiskEventV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'risk-event-v2-1'
risk_event_id, run_id must be lowercase SHA-256
event_time must be UTC
phase must be RiskPhase enum
decision must be RiskDecision enum
market, instrument_id, risk_policy_version must be non-empty strings
reason_codes must be non-empty and unique
source_event_ids must be unique

contracts.name: BacktestResultIdentityV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'backtest-result-v2-1'
result_id, run_id, configuration_fingerprint, dataset_fingerprint, economic_fingerprint must be lowercase SHA-256
strategy_version, execution_policy_version, accounting_version, risk_policy_version must be non-empty strings
started_at and ended_at must be UTC
ended_at >= started_at
simulation_only must be True (v2 Phase 1 results are simulation only)
source_record_ids must be unique

contracts.name: EvidenceRecord
invariants: schema_version must be 'evidence-record-v2-1'
evidence_id, source_organization, document_identity, local_snapshot_path, market, instrument_id must be non-empty strings
snapshot_sha256 must be 64-char lowercase hex
retrieved_at, effective_from must be UTC
effective_to if present must be UTC and > effective_from
fact_names must be non-empty

contracts.name: SpecificationRecord
invariants: schema_version must be 'economic-specification-v2-1'
specification_id, market, instrument_id must be non-empty strings
effective_from must be UTC
effective_to if present must be UTC and > effective_from
values must be non-empty, uniquely named, lexically ordered, with non-empty string values
production specifications require evidence lineage (unless synthetic_test_only)
synthetic_test_only and owner_approved cannot both be true

contracts.name: SpecificationRepository
invariants: evidence_ids must be unique
specification_ids must be unique
all specification evidence_ids must be subset of known evidence_ids

contracts.name: OrderLedgerEventV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'order-ledger-event-v2-1'
event_id, order_id, source_event_id must be lowercase SHA-256
kind must be LedgerEventKind
event_time must be UTC
sequence_number must be positive integer (not bool)
expected_order_version must be nonnegative integer (not bool)
market, instrument_id, reason_code must be non-empty strings
contract_id if present must be non-empty string
fill_quantity if present must be finite Decimal

contracts.name: OrderLedgerTransitionV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'order-ledger-transition-v2-1'
ledger_version must be 'order-ledger-v2-1'
transition_id, order_id, source_event_id, event_id, event_fingerprint must be lowercase SHA-256
parent_order_id, child_order_id if present must be SHA-256
market, instrument_id, reason_code must be non-empty strings
event_time must be UTC
sequence_number and transition_ordinal must be positive integers
previous_state and resulting_state must be OrderState enums
accepted_quantity, filled_quantity, remaining_quantity must be nonnegative finite Decimal
accepted_quantity == filled_quantity + remaining_quantity (quantity conservation)

contracts.name: OrderLedgerSnapshotV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'order-ledger-snapshot-v2-1'
intent must be OrderIntentV2
state must be OrderState
order_version and last_sequence_number must be nonnegative integers (not bool)
last_event_time if present must be UTC
accepted_quantity, filled_quantity, remaining_quantity must be nonnegative finite Decimal
accepted_quantity == filled_quantity + remaining_quantity (quantity conservation)
transition_ids must each be SHA-256
replacement_child_order_id if present must be SHA-256

contracts.name: OrderLedgerV2
invariants: schema_version must be 'order-ledger-v2-1'
ledger_version must be 'order-ledger-v2-1'
ledger_fingerprint if non-empty must be lowercase SHA-256
order_ids must be unique
event_ids must be unique
apply() returns new ledger (immutable)
exact duplicate event returns same ledger (idempotent)
conflicting event_id reuse raises DUPLICATE_EVENT_CONFLICT
sequence_number must equal len(events)+1
event_time must not regress
equal-timestamp events ordered by priority then event_id
expected_order_version must match snapshot.order_version
terminal states reject all events
invalid transitions reject with specific reason codes
GTC fill/trigger/execution requires contract_eligibility_verified
DAY expire requires session_boundary_verified
GTC expire requires contract_eligibility_verified
stop orders require trigger before fill
stop-limit fill must follow trigger event
fill_quantity must be positive and <= remaining
IOC partial fill cancels residual
IOC double evaluation rejected
replace creates linked child and parent REPLACED
